tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dpal chen yang dag he ru ka'i snying po zla gam gcig ma la brten pa'i bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya ba'i yi ge thugs kyi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na maḥshrī gu ra be/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgyes pa che// mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /bla ma yang dag he ru kar// btud nas bsdus pa'i bsnyen thabs bri// gangs can gyi ljongs su snga 'gyur ba'i smin grol byin rlabs snyan grags kyi gzi brjid zam ma chad pa dpal ldan sa skya'i yab chos zla gam dgu pa rgyun gyi nyams len dang*/ grangs dus kyi bsnyen pa gtong ba'i tshe bzlas sgom khyer bde bas don gyi snying po zla gam gcig ma la phyag bzhes su mdzad cing*/ de'i sgrub thabs kyi rtsa ba slob dpon chen po hūm̐ ka ras mdzad pa'i lag len gan pa rin rgyal gyis mdzad pa la/ chos rje dpal ldan bla mas mdzad pa'i phur pa'i mngon rtogs sogs dang bstun pa'i gsal byed 'jam mgon sa lo chen pos mdzad pa gzhir bzhag gsal byed kyi yig cha sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i nyams len snying por dril ba la don gsum/ bsnyen pa'i bca' gzhi/ bsnyen thabs kyi nyams len dngos/ bsnyen pa grub nas bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ dben zhing nyams dga' la byin rlabs can gyi gnas su rten spyi dang khyad par dam tshig gi bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du 'dzom zhing spro na rnying ma spyi'i phyag srol ltar/ maṇ+ḍal dri dang bdud rtsi lngas byugs pa la zla gam dmar skya sgo gcig pa la phyag mtshan nam thig le sngon po bkod pa'i steng du mañji'i khar thod pa mtshan ldan la sku'am sngags dang rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ bris shing rab gnas byas/ dar mthing ga'i na bzas klubs pa bslangs nas bzhugs pa'i mdun du bhan+dha la zhu chen gyi mar me bgyis pa dgod/ de'i mdun du gtor ma stod zur gsum/

smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba la/ ched du bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i g.yas g.yon sman raka mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rnams/ spros pa bsdu na sman raka gtor gsum phyi mchod tsam la brten pa brgyud pa 'di'i rtsa ba'i phyag len yin la/ de ltar na dkar mo'i zlum gtor/ bdud rgyal gyi gtor 'bul zur gsum rnams kyang bkod par gsung*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod/ me tog ḍa ma ru/ rdo dril sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa nyams su blang bya'i sgrub thabs dngos bshad/ bsnyen thabs kyi lag len mdo tsam bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ mchod rdzas rnams la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas mchod rdzas kyi ming yig dang po rnams 'phros 'dus pa las mchod rdzas rnams la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ pa na peṃ pe nu su ru to ti pu pa ra mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi hu/ sa ma yo ta muḥsarba ma hā su kha sid+dhi hu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ mchod pa'i lha mo kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams spro bas nam mkha' gang bar bsams la rol mo bya/ spro na sa phur ltar mchod pa dang rol mo byin brlab/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor bya'o// rgyud sbyang ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs mkha' khyab tu sad par mos la/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rangs// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la// dag pa gsum gyis lus dbul lo// tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes lan gsum brjod la/

tshogs zhing rnams rang la bsdu/ tshad med bsgom pa ni/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dpal he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ yum khro mo dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra añja li hūm̐/ badz+ra bhan+dha/ badz+ra añja li dza/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ phaṭa/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams// song zhig lha min lha yang rung*// nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos// oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa sogs khro bcu'i sngags brjod/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas khro bo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim/ yang rang gi thugs ka nas mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs byung ste sna bug nas 'thon/ g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs bskrad de rwa bar gyur/ hūm̐/ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir// khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i// mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srungs// oṃ badz+ra a yu dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel gung mdzub brkyang ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ yang g.yon nas bskor te mtshon cha'i gur du gyur nas bgegs kyis mi tshugs par bsams la/ sngar gyi phyag rgya dang sngags la phaṭa bzhag pa brjod/ srung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan cing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mtheb mdzub gnyis rtse sprad pa rin po che'i rnam par byas pa dang*/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas// dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chad kyi// log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// oṃ badz+ra te dza tīk+ṣ+ṇa tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces dang*/ g.yon skor dang sngags la phaṭa bzhag pa gong bzhin/ rwa ba de dag las 'phros pa'i me 'od kyis bgegs thams cad bsregs par bsam zhing*/ thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i sor mo gzhan rnams bsnol/ mthe bong rtse sprad pa dang*/ phyi rol kun tu 'od 'phros pas// bdud dpung nges par sreg byed pa// sa dang mkha' kun khyab pa yi// 'bar ba me yi phung por gyur// oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ bshags pa ni/ bshags yul rgyud sbyang ba'i skabs ltar gsal btab la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ sdom gsum sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang*// rtsa ba yan lag nyes byas phra mo dang*// dam tshig che chung tshor dang ma tshor dang*// zla dang zhor gyis dam tshig nyams pa dang*// khas len che la nyams len chung ba dang*// bka' ltar ma bgyis gzhung ltar ma bsrangs dang*// ting 'dzin klod gyur dzab bzlas nyung ba dang*// yi dam lha yi sgom pa g.yel la sogs// nyams grib nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma// dpal chen yang dag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// dur khrod brgyad gnas dam can mkha' 'gro la// sngar byas 'gyod dang phyin chad sdom sems kyis// sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang du bshags par bgyi// mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes stobs bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bshags te lha tshogs rnams rang gi snying gar thim par mos/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ a la la hoḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ nang mchod byin rlabs ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsregs gtor bkrus/

swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ ram̐ kam̐ las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs par hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams 'od du zhu nas rlangs pa hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+ṝk oṃ dzi na dzika swā rat+na dh+rik oṃ ā ro l̥k hā pradz+nyā dhṛk he ru ka yab yum bcur gyur/ sa ma ya hoḥ sbyor ba'i mes 'od du zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas thim/ 'og gi bdud rtsi gtor ma dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ gsum gyis byin brlab/ rak+ta'i snod a las thod pa yangs par ra las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ gsum gyis brlab bo// ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong zhing spros pa dang bral ba'i de bzhin nyid do// oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gnas lugs ma rtogs pa la snying rje shar ba kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin no// stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rang rtsal hūm̐ sngon po/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin no// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros pas tha mal gyi snang yul bsregs gtor bkrus nas dag par byas/ e yam̐ bam̐ ram̐ lam̐ ram̐ kam̐ bh+rūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/

e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil// yam̐ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan// de steng bam̐ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar// ram̐ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed// lam̐ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur// de steng rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs// dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng*// bde chen byang chub sems nyid gzhal yas khang*// dkar dmar mdog can zla gam sgo gcig pa// pa pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ ma hā de ba dzaḥ u ma de bī dzaḥ pad+ma nyi ma zla ba drag po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de babs pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus 'od du zhu bas rang dpal chen yang dag gi skur gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ hūm̐/ dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal// bcom ldan rdo rje he ru ka /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas// dril bu thod khrag rgyu zhags g.yon// rdo rje khyung gshog rab tu gdengs// mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar// ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes// glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol// stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can// dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul bgyis brgyan// dbu rgyan se ral sked chings dang*// phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can// rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi// thig le zo ris tshom bur byas// sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras// zhabs bzhi g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs nas// dbang phyug kha bub mgo bo dang*// u ma'i nu mar rab brdzis shing*// ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs// oṃ badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ yum chen khro mo dbang phyug sngo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje// g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob// gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la spras// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// skam po lnga bcus do shal byas// sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyis// thig le zo ris tshom bur byas// zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum gyis// yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/

lus dkyil gsal 'debs pa ni/ rang lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba ni/ byang khog chos kyi 'byung gnas/ nang gi dbugs ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi drod me/ chu ser dang sha lpags chu dang sa/ rtsa sbubs kyi khrag rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ rgal tshigs keng rus kyi ri rab/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa'i bu ga bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ tsit+ta gzhal yas khang zla gam/ srog pa rtsa sgo gcig pa/ snying tshil dkar dmar nyi zla'i gdan/ dbang po lnga mchod pa'i lha mo ste rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ spyi gtsug tu badz+ra he ru ka sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ mtshog mar bud+dha he ru ka dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ rna ba g.yas par rat+na he ru ka ser po g.yas rin po che/ ltag par pad+ma he ru ka dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ rna ba g.yon par karma he ru ka ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ dpral bar sku rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon rnams rang rtags kyis yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang 'od kyi rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas la gau rī/ g.yon la pra mo ha/ phyag g.yas dang po tsau rī/ g.yon dang po bai tā li/ g.yas bar par puk+ka sī/ tha ma sh+ma sha nī/ g.yon bar pa ghasma rī/ tha ma tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rgal tshigs dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad du rdzogs pa'o// snying ga'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra tshon gang ba'i thugs kar rin po che zur brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte ba la/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar ru lu skra shad kyis bris pa lta bus bskor ba'o// ye shes pa bskyed bstim rgyas gdab ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod// dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor he ru ka rig lnga yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhī shwa rī oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhī shwa rī trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhī shra rī hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa rī āḥ mchod yul spyan drang ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas dpal chen yang dag lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+wa sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum dang*// sprul pa yang sprul bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs// glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas// ye shes thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra sa mā dzaḥ snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam zhing*/ sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma// mar me dri chab nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas// bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la// rnam dag blo yis mos blos bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trām̐/

oṃ badz+ra gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nīrti āḥ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe trām̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ badz+ra nai bi d+yā hūm̐/ badz+ra shab+da hūm̐/ sman mchod ni/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi// rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas// rgyud lnga sems can kun grol zhing*// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po// thugs dam dbyings nas bskul ba'i phyir// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la// sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du// bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags na// bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la// 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la ban+dha ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// he ru ka dpal gnas yul sgo skyong ma// dbang phyug mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ nang mchod myangs la/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i// rig 'dzin bdag cag thams cad la// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ rtog med spros bral mkha' dbyings dag /skye med sku gsung thugs mnga' ba// rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha// zhi khro rab 'byams 'khor dang bcas// stong nyid dbyings nas thugs dam bskul// sprul pa'i dbyings nas gshegs su gsol// dngos po'i mtshan mar gzung du med// rtog bral yid kyi mchod pa 'dis// dgongs pa zab mo thugs dam bskang*// chos sku'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī he ru ka a mṛ ta sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/

gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga po// chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang*// ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ 'di// dam rdzas khrag chen chags pa yi// ma bcos dbyings su dag bya'i phyir// dpal chen khrag 'thung zhal du 'bul// oṃ shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ/ ma hā rak+ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs mnyam nyid chos kyi dbyings// ma skyes rdo rje kun tu bzang*// thabs mkhas khro rgyal skur ston pa// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku la chags mi mnga'// dgyes mdzad dpal chen sku la 'khril// shes rab gnyis med bde chen rdzogs// khro mo dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin dang*// 'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa yi// lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol// khams gsum chos nyid dur khrod la// nyon mongs dug gsum thams cad ni// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor lo// tsit+ta mkha' mnyam rgyal po ni// kun gzhi ma bcos thig le la// rang byung ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med// de nas zla gam dgu pa dang*// ye shes me dgu gcig tu gsal// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// 'bras bu sku gsung thugs su shar// dpal chen ye shes skur gsal ba// thig le chen po ye shes sku// sems nyid ma bcos rang byung gi// 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pas bstod/ de nas dzab bzla ba ni/ snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs rang la thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/

dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni// ye shes tshon gang rin po che// thugs kyi snying po 'bru brgyad 'phros// 'od zer gsal bar kun la khyab// oṃ ni 'bar ba'i seng ge brjid// ma tshogs sprin dang skar ltar 'phro// hūm̐ chen nyi zla'i tshogs rgyun 'dra// ma nor re skong mkha' la 'gro// oṃ ni ye shes lnga dang ldan// ru ni 'bar srog chags sdang 'joms// lu ni kun bzang bde ba'i yum// hūm̐ ni ye shes tshad med bzhi// bh+yo ni gnas gyur ma 'gags pa// hūm̐ gis byin rlabs sdud par byed// ru lu 'di ltar ya mtshan che// ru lu rtogs pa gong du 'phel// ru lu dngos grub ma lus ster// ces brjod cing don nges par byas la/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes 'bru brgyad pa nyid ci nus bzla/ thun mthar/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas yum gyi snying po'ang ci rigs par bzla'o// thun bsdu ba na/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das dpal chen he ru ka'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bdag bskyed la phyi mchod sgeg phreng sogs gong bzhin dang*/ nang mchod bdud rtsi sngags tsam gyis 'bul/ bstod pa yab yum sh+lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ mchod pa'i don du spyan drangs pa'i lha la dmigs te/ ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// 'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa// thugs dam dbang gis bdag la brtser dgongs nas// drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/

ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs/ bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu ni// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// bcad gtubs lus la mi 'byung zhing*// gzi mdangs nyi 'od bzhin du shog /ces dang*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa rim gyis bsdus/ yum yab la thim/ rang nyid he ru ka'i skur gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ka ba tsi rak+ṣa hūm̐/ smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun// bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ khrag 'thung rgyal po he ru ka dpal gyi// 'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /shis brjod ni/ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las// thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa// bcom ldan he ru ka dpal yab yum gyi// skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /ces pa tsam bya ste/ rgyun gyi nyams len la ni de tsam gyis don 'dus pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ bsnyen pa la 'jug pa'i snga logs su dam tshig gso ba'i bdag 'jug dang*/ yig brgya'i sgom bzlas/ bar chad sel zhing dngos grub 'grub pa'i dpung skul swats+tsha chu gtor sogs ci 'grub byas la/ dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen brgyad dam bcu'am bcu bzhi gza' skar 'phrod sbyor shis pa'i dgong mo dbang gi dus su dbu 'dzugs/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu mi dang mi ma yin pa'i rgyu 'grul srung ba'i tho 'dzugs shing bgegs bskrad brtan bzhugs shis brjod tsam byas la/ nang du mi 'jug ka med kyi mi dang dngos po dmigs khongs su bcug gzhan gtong len rgyu 'grul dang smra ba bcad la/ kha shar ram lhor phyogs pas stan bde ba la 'khod de mchod pa byin brlab nas brtsams mthar chags su btang ste/

thun gnyis sam gsum mam bzhi ji ltar bde ba'i rim pas sgom bzlas la 'jug snga thun srod thun gnyis la dkar bdud phur srung rnams kyi gtor 'bul re'ang mdzad pa'i phyag srol snang zhing*/ gnyis kar ma 'grub kyang srod thun la bya/ de'i tshe thun mjug mchod bstod grub ma thag par byin rlabs nas brtsams bstod pa'i bar btang la dngos grub blang ba gshegs bsdu chab gcig bya/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis dus zla ba gcig dang*/ grangs ru lu 'bum phrag brgyad dam bcu/ yum la de'i bcu cha gnyis ka'i kha skong dang bcas pa bzla/ dus grangs thems pa'i snga dro la tshogs kyi yo byad rgyas par bsham/ thun mtha'i mchod bstod/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul grub pa dang tshogs brtan ma'i bar du btang la/ dngos grub blang ba man chad dkyus ltar la bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya/ kha skong ngam nus pa'i 'byin pa'i sbyin sreg ni mtshams khongs de nyid du grub na mchog tu 'gyur zhing*/ de dag zin nas mtshams tho bsdu zhing bags kyis glod pa sogs mtshams kyi spang blang spyi dang 'dra'o// de la dkar bdud gnyis kyi gtor 'bul rgyas par spro na sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i phur ba'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od can ltar bya/ mdor bsdus na/ gtor ma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥgasum gyis byin brlab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkar mo nyi zla dang*/ bdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ che ba'i che mchog gsang ba'i gzugs// thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma// dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can// srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po yang*// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ rdor thal phye la/

oṃ badz+ra shān+tiṃ pad+ma ku ru ti bh+yo/ oṃ sarba mā ra kṛṣ+ṇa ka pā la mā la dha ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta bhūñja kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trūn bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum mam lngas gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shān+tiṃ ku ru/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ ba shaṃ ku ru/ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes pas nang mchod phul nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan dkar mo chen mo ni// sngon tshe che mchog he ru ka'i// spyan sngar khas blangs de bzhin du// bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba dang*// dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba dang*// sgrub po 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang*// bsam pa'i don rnams bsgrub pa dang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐/ sngon tshe bdud kun gyi ni bdag po che// shin tu mi bzad rdo rje khrag 'thung gi// spyan sngar dam bcas bdud rgyal thod phreng can// mthu rtsal rmad byung nag po che la bstod// thugs dam rjes dgongs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces bstod/ phur srung ni 'khon rabs kyi bka' srung thun min yin kyang dkyus 'dir ma byas pas chad skyon med do// gsum pa ni/ tshogs rdzas rnams nang mchod kyis bsang sbyangs la/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bi sho dha ni swā hā/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sogs sman gtor byin rlabs ltar byas la/ 'og gi tshogs rdzas dang 'dres pas/ zhes bsgyur cing*/ sngags oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐/ zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs dang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams// kun bzang mchod sprin tshogs 'bul gyi// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ dang po mchod pa ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan// thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol// dam tshig sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog 'di// bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul// longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni// chos nyid ngang la chos nyid rol// a la la hoḥbazhes su gsol// rol du gsol/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes brjod cing tshogs phud gtor ma la phul/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa rnams// gti mug dbang gis byas pa dag /'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas pa yis// lha tshogs khyed la mthol lo bshags// zhes dang yig brgya brjod/ tha ma bsgral mchod ni/ tshogs kyi dum bu'am liṅga mdun du bkod la/ 'gugs gzhug sogs sa phur ltar ram/ bsdu na/ na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po badz+ra he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis ma rungs pa'i sems can bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig oṃ ram̐ kro dha dz+wa la ram̐ hūm̐/ he he phaṭa/ kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes sgo ba bzhi'i phyag rgyas 'gugs 'chings sdom myos byas la/ e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /'bar ba gtum chen rngams pa la// khros pa'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya// sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig /bdud rtsi lnga'am zas lnga la// mtshan ma ming du bcas pa bya// bkug nas rdo rje phur bus gdab// rdul du byas nas tshogs la 'bul// tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa dang ldan pas phur bus btab la/ oṃ gha gha/

ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa na/ badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba sha trūn bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing ral gris gtubs pa sman rag gis bran la/ bla ma la ni brnyes byed dang*// dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs// dam tshig gnyan po dral byed pa// gnod byed ma lus zhal du bstab// badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā hi/ zhes gtor ma la bstab/ hoḥ bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon dang*// mched dang lcam dral ma lus pa// zhal zas tshogs la rol pa yis// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// a la la hoḥ zhes brjod cing tshogs la rol/ phud lhag bdud rtsis bran/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ pho nya phra men ma/ 'bar ma/ dbang phyug ma/ ma bdun sring bzhi la sogs pa pho nya sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs rnams skad cig gis bkug par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ āḥ zhes 'bul/ dman lhag bdud rtsi'i kha phrus btab la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ging dang dbang phyug ma// ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad// pho nya la sogs lhag sdud tshogs// dpal gyi pham phabs 'di gsol la// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ zhes brjod cing lhag ma la chang gi kha phru btab nas/ sarba a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lhag ma btang zhing phyi rol du dor ro// de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni/ sgrub khang gi steng ngam gnas de nyid du rdo rje'i khyung gshog gi phyag rgya bcas/ ho/ bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/

dpal chen po pham phabs la mnos te rnal 'byor pa'i stong dang grogs la nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo bzhi/ dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin ma chen mo bzhi/ dkar sham bzhin bzang gi bu mo sman btsun ma chen mo bzhi rnams sngon gyi thugs dam las ma 'da' bar 'dir gshegs shig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki nī hūm̐ dzaḥ e ā ra li hriṃ hriṃ/ zhes brjod cing bkug la gong du bcas pa'i phyag rgyas zil gyis mnan te/ bh+yoḥ bka' yi bran g.yog tshogs dang bcas nyid du// dpal ldan khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs brtan ma skyong ma rnams// sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs te// 'dir gshegs dam dgongs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces brjod nas sman rag sbran/ gtor ma khang steng du phul la/ ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes gshegs su gsol lo// tshogs mchod 'di ltar dus bzang gi mchod pa lta bur btang yang chog la/ de'i tshe na'ang srung ma'i gtor 'bul grub pa dang 'di nyid tshang bar btang la/ mthar dngos grub blang ba man chad sbyar bas legs par 'grub bo// grub pa brgyud mar byon rnams kyi// mchog dngos sgrub pa'i lha mchog 'di'i// rim pa gnyis kyis rdo rje'i lam// skye 'di nyid la myur bgrod shog /ces pa'ang rang gzhan la phan par 'dod pas pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi gsung rab las snying por dril te sbyar ba nongs pa'i tshogs rnams bshags shing*/ dge bas dpal he ru ka mchog gi phyag rgya 'grub par gyur cig dge legs 'phel// ༈ /yang dag he ru ka 'khon lugs zla gam dgu pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nyes pa kun sbyong zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru be/ bdag med phyogs bral don dam mes// 'khrul snang gdug pa'i tshang tshing sreg

/dpal ldan bla ma he ru kar// btud nas sreg blugs bya ba 'chad// 'khon ston 'jam dbyangs gong ma rnams kyis phur pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor kho na la brten pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi tshe dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sreg blugs 'bul ba'i phyag bzhes kyis 'dir yang rigs 'gre bar mdzad pas/ yang dag zla gam gcig ma la brten pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong du bya chog cing*/ lha dgu'i bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su khyer bde ba'i sreg blugs kyi las rim 'chad pa la gnyis/ yo byad 'du bya ba/ cho ga dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su gnas de nyid du bya ba yin la/ gnas gzhan du byed na sa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pas sa gzhi dul bar byas pa la/ me thab thig chen brgyad btab pa'i steng du khru phyed kyis zlum por bskor ba thab dngos/ de rgyab sor bzhi kha khyer/ sor bzhi mu ran/ de rgyab gru bzhir bcad pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje nang bstan dang*/ stegs bu'i dpangs tshad dam mdzes char gru bzhi'i rgyab tu'ang cha ga sor bzhi pa bya/ nang sum cha zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su zla gam sgo gcig pa rang la bstan pa dang*/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du zla gam sgo gcig pa sgo rnams dbus la bstan pa re re ste dgu/ kha khyer mu ran gang rung la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor/ thab kyi gzhi dkar po la bcad tshon rnams dmar skyas bya zhing tshon sel gzhan ma phog pa gnad che/ lha'i gnas rnams su me tog tshom bu'am/ so so'i sku mdog dang bstun pa'i tshon phung bya/ rgyas par dbus su pad nyi la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po/ shar du zhing dbyug sogs phyag mtshan so sor bris la/ 'o ma can gyi shing ngam/ de med na srog chags med pa'i lci bas thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs pa la nang gi shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba zhig bzhag mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byug

de'i mdun du rang gi stan nang tshang can dkar po bting*/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma dkar zlum gnyis/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon nas bud shing rgyu las byas pa'i yam shing sor bcu gnyis pa/ mar khu/ ti lam yungs kar/ zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūrba/ ku sha rnams rim par dgod/ mchod sreg gi rdzas dang snod dang stegs thams cad kha dog dkar po/ snod kyi dbyibs zlum po bya/ gzhan yang ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang*/ rang gi mdun du bsang chu'i snod/ ku sha'i 'thor g.yab/ rdo rje dril bu/ ḍa ma ru/ 'thor nas/ nang gi mchod pa rnams bsham/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar la bzhag rang dang thab kyi bar du me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa bzhag rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi lngas bran/ phyi phyed kyi dus su sgrub pa po khrus bya/ gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la sdig pa dang bar chad zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas kha shar du bstan la skyil krung ngam pus 'khyud bcas tsog pu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis 'dug go /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa gsol gdab kyi bar sngon du song nas/ sreg blugs dngos la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po la me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyi mi sbar zhing shin tu 'bar bar bsams la dngos su me spar/ 'di nas brtsams lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar rdor dril bzung ba dang smra ba bcad pa sogs spyod lam nges pa can du bya'o// bsang chu sgrub pa ni/ 'og gi las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad thams cad kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig tsam bzlas la thab dang yo byad rnams la 'thor te/ sngags de nyid dang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ud pa la hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bit+pū ra ya hūm̐/ zhes mchod rdzas rnams byin brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ 'bru/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdzas thams cad sbyang*/ thab la bsang chu gtor nas las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing*/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas par gyur/ ces mos/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba/ ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas bgrang phreng dang*/

g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sma ra'i ag tshom can drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros te shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dza sarba karma pra sā dha ka ma hā bhū ta de wa ṛ ṣi dwi dza satwa ma gṛ hi tā/ sarba satwār+tha kṛtwā a hūm̐/ ti asmi san+ni hi twā bha wa/ zhes spyan drang*/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod de/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a na ma ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la ya sarba duṣ+ṭān bha smin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya hūm̐/ zhes dam la bzhag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dam ye bsre/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad la bsang chu gtor nas bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge// sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// 'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes pas ku sha'i rtse mo g.yas skor du thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram/ rdo lcags gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba ma yin pa zhi ba'i rgyu las byung ba'i me sbor byed las sngags kyis bsang*/ thab la g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes pas thab kyi nang gi ting lo dang bcas pa'i me sbar/ sngags de dang mar dgang blugs gsum phul la me gso/ de nas/ me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye dī bya pi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bah+ṇa ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar me thab la lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod mtheb srin gyis gtor la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ skabs 'dir me'i pra brtag par bshad cing*/ de'ang kha dog dkar zhing snum pa sgra cung zad dang bcas pa du ba chung ba zhi ba'i las la dge'o// du ba che ba me stag rab tu 'phro ba ni bgegs dang bcas pa yin pas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu phyogs kun tu gtor ro// de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ thog mar yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/

oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ zhes pa bdun gyis phul mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gres te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar khu dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ til lam yungs kar dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zas mchog dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ so ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ 'bras dang*/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma r+ye swā hā/ gro dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hā/ ku sha rnams phul la/ sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyar/ de nas bsang chu nas me nang du cung zad blugs la/ oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ añca mā naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ mar blugs gzar gang thab nang du blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ slar me gso ba'i phyir bud shing brtsig pa dang*/ mchod pa bsreg rdzas rnams kha cung zad gsos la/ bsang sbyang*/ me'i dbus su bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ spros/ hūm̐ las ram̐ e yam̐ ra bam̐ kiṃ ram̐ rnams 'og tu chad sogs lha dgu'i sgrub thabs ltar la/ bh+rūm̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las khro bo rol pa'i pho brang chen po gru bzhi sgo bzhi nas/ me phung 'bar ba'o// hūm̐ las pa ma a rnams 'og tu chad/ slar yang dzaḥyig 'od kyi lcags kyus lha chen pho mo bkug pa pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ ma hā de ba dzaḥ u ma de bī dzaḥ ma traṃ dzaḥ dbus su pad+ma nyi zla drag po pho mo'i gdan/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan re re/

gdan de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du gam̐ tsam̐ pram̐ bam̐ pam̐ gham̐ sham̐ tsam̐/ sa bon de rnams las 'od 'phros 'dus don gnyis byas/ yongs su gyur ba las/ dbus su dpal chen badz+ra he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag sogs nas/ g.yas brkyang gis yab la sbyor ba/ shar du gau rī sngon mo sogs sa bon dang bskyed sngags dor ba'i/ lus dang ye shes la rdo rje sems dpa'o// dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drang ba ni/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mthar/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod// dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyi ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor he ru ka rigs lnga yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhī shwa rī oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhī shwa rī tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa rī āḥ zhes dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab/ de nas byon zan 'bul ba ni/ ru lu lan gsum gyi mthar/

oṃ ag+na ye zhes sogs spel tshig dang bcas pa gong me lha'i skabs bzhin phul/ slar yang mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin brlabs la/ sgeg phreng sogs phyi nang gsang gsum gtor ma rak+ta bstod pa'i bar zla gam gcig pa'i sgrub thabs ltar tshang bar bya/ de nas yam shing ku sha'i bar bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i go rim dang spel tshig gong ltar la/ sngags ru lu 'ba' zhig gis 'bul/ bsnyen pa kha gso'i skabs su til lam yungs kar gang rung la grangs 'dzin pa ste/ cho ga gcig la'ang 'bul tshan bcu gcig yod pa'i bcu la ru lu stong phrag re bzlas pas khri tshar bar 'gyur ro// skabs skabs su me gso ba'i phyir yam shing dang mar ji ltar rigs pa 'bul/ bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams brgya rtsa re 'bul dgos par dus gcig la phul na me mi 'bar ba'i skyon yong bas skabs su gang babs re 'bul/ mthar mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun spel tshig bcas gong ltar bya/ de nas phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa'i mchod pa bcas mdor bsdus tsam dang*/ dkar bdud kyi gtor 'bul/ tshogs mchod spro na byin rlabs nas brtan skyong gi bar sgrub thabs chung ba ltar bya/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs kyis dngos grub blang*/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyis thab kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba blangs pa dpral bar reg go /gsum pa rjes kyi las rim ni/ thab khung du mar blugs gzar dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pa blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod la/ me lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i sku can du gyur par bsam/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams so so'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bdun re dbul/ slar yang mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun phul la/

mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ me lha'i gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri bā ra a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ sngags de'i gsham du ar+ghaṃ sogs btags pas phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi mthar/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur ston pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs// rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gun+dhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes bstod/ drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol la gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ añca mā naṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/

slar yang yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ go cha bgo ba dang smon lam bkra shis rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ me rang bzhin gyis yal ba dang thal ba rnams legs par bsdus la rgyun 'bab kyi chu bor blug par bya'o// 'di ni bsnyen pa'i kha skong gtso bor bstan gyi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed nas/ dkyil 'khor las ye shes pa'i tshul du tshom bu spyan 'dren gyi tshig gis drangs la/ lha rnams bzhugs su gsol zhing gsal btab ste mchod pa dang*/ rjes ye shes pa tshom bu dang dbyer med dkyil 'khor ltar gshegs pa sogs khyad chos bye brag pa rnams spyi dang 'dra'o// las kyi me srog yam shing mar gyis gsos// de las ye shes dkyil 'khor bsreg rdzas kyi// dwangs mas bcud brtas des kyang rnal 'byor gyi// thar pa'i srog rtsa bdud rtsis rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i dgongs don sor bzhag gsar du sbyar ba'i sgrub dkyil che chung rnams dang 'brel bar blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs yang khrod chos kyi pho brang du bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
